text: OVERDOSAGE In the event of overdosage, discontinue infusion containing sodium acetate immediately and institute corrective therapy as indicated to reduce elevated serum sodium levels, and restore acid- base balance if necessary. (see WARNINGS , PRECAUTIONS and ADVERSE REACTIONS ).
